Jiangxi Province Key Laboratory of Molecular Medicine, Nanchang 330006, China)Abstract: OBJECTIVE To study the effect of ophiopogonin D (OPD) on the acute and sub-acute toxicity of ophiopogonin D′ (OPD′ ). METHODS ① The acute toxicity was determined with the Bliss method. The mice were divided into ${ \mathsf { O P D } } ^ { \prime } , { \mathsf { O P D } } { + } { \mathsf { O P D } } ^ { \prime }$ (OPD and $\mathsf { O P D ^ { \prime } }$ were pre-mixed) and OPD→ OPD′ (OPD was injected 15 min before $\mathsf { O P D ^ { \prime } }$ ) groups. Five doses of OPD′ 3.127, 6.460, 9.979, 10.245 and $1 3 . 0 9 8 ~ \mathsf { m g } \cdot \mathsf { k g } ^ { - 1 }$ were set in the OPD′group. The doses of OPD and $\mathsf { O P D ^ { \prime } }$ were set at 1:1 and 5 doses of 5.711, 6.129, 7.626, 8.712 and 10.262 mg·kg-1 were set in the ${ \mathsf { O P D + O P D ^ { \prime } } }$ group. The doses of OPD′ were 11.351, 15.551, 22.732, 26.568 and 30.137 mg · kg-1 , and OPD was fixed at 1.0 mg·kg-1 in the ${ \mathsf { O P D } } { \longrightarrow } { \mathsf { O P D } } ^ { \prime }$ group. Behavioral changes and number of dead mice were observed and recorded within 14 d of single tail vein injection. ② In the sub-acute toxicity study, 5 groups, namely normal control, OPD (0.25 mg·kg-1 ), OPD′ (0.25 mg·kg-1 ), OPD+OPD′ $( 0 . 2 5 ~ \mathsf { m g } \cdot \mathsf { k g } ^ { - 1 } + 0 . 2 5 ~ \mathsf { m g } \cdot \mathsf { k g } ^ { - 1 } )$ and OPD→OPD′ (0.25 mg·kg-1 →0.25 mg·kg-1 ) groups, were set and given once a day by tail vein injection for 30 consecutive days. Pathological changes of the heart, liver, spleen, lung, and kidney tissues, changes in blood routine, blood biochemistry indexes, and organ indexes were observed and recorded. RESULTS ① In the acute toxicity test, the $\mathsf { L D } _ { 5 0 }$ value of OPD′ was $7 . 7 8 5 ~ \mathsf { m g } \cdot \mathsf { k g } ^ { - 1 }$ in the $\mathsf { O P D ^ { \prime } }$ group;
